newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $110/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle up $1 at $110/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were firm to mostly $1.00 per cwt higher on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 108.00- 110.00. (weighted average 108.90).
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1200 lbs 108.00- 110.00. (weighted average 109.03).

Trade on slaughter steers and heifers was slow on Tuesday morning, turning moderately active at noon. Prices were not fully established on either class on a live basis. Buyer inquiry moderate to good, seller interest mixed.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs 66.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1200 lbs 66.00, few 65.00).
Wk To Date- 18,800 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 23,700 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 3,200
